name: Disco
description: A light-up disco floor: square tiles glowing from the middle out, bright in drifting patches and dim between, with a sparkle on a few.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 5%; border-radius: 6%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); opacity: @rn(.42, 1.25); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(closest-side, #000 25%, #0000008c 100%); mask: radial-gradient(closest-side, #000 25%, #0000008c 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 52%; top: 12%; width: 36%; height: 36%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--spark); clip-path: @var(--spark); transform: scale(@p(0, 0, 0, 1)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --spark: polygon(50% 0%, 58% 42%, 100% 50%, 58% 58%, 50% 100%, 42% 58%, 0% 50%, 42% 42%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
